amendment_reason: The 1.99 GB ScienceBase NLCD archive was not anonymously downloadable in the workstation environment: the manager endpoint returned a frontend shell and the public S3 object required requester-pays/authenticated access. A public ImageServer export of the same named NLCD 2021 categorical product was therefore used only for the planned descriptive covariate audit.

accepted_source.service: Esri Living Atlas USA Annual NLCD Land Cover ImageServer

boundary: The exported raster is a traceable audit covariate, not a replacement claim that the full ScienceBase archive was downloaded. It is not used for retraining, checkpoint selection, or any geological interpretation.
change_scope: no change to river source, target grid, V4.2 probabilities, folds, labels, or model metrics
